SELECT s.store_id >= 900 AS pseudo, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-05-04'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3
SELECT sale_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, sum(net_amount) net, max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-09-14' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current),
sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.region, s.store_id,
         sum(f.net_amount) gross_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN cur c ON c.store_id=s.store_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_period<=5
  GROUP BY ALL),
rets AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.region, s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ref_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN cur c ON c.store_id=s.store_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_period<=5
  GROUP BY ALL),
rpt AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.region, sum(p.net_sales) rpt_net, sum(p.net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, sum(p.returns_net) rpt_ret
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales p JOIN cur c ON c.store_id=p.store_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=p.business_date
  WHERE p.store_id<900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_period<=5 GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.region, sum(s.gross_net) sales, sum(s.staff_net) staff, max(r.ref_net) refunds_unused, 
 (SELECT sum(ref_net) FROM rets x WHERE x.fiscal_year=s.fiscal_year AND x.region=s.region) refunds,
 (SELECT rpt_net FROM rpt x WHERE x.fiscal_year=s.fiscal_year AND x.region=s.region) rpt_net,
 (SELECT rpt_gross FROM rpt x WHERE x.fiscal_year=s.fiscal_year AND x.region=s.region) rpt_gross,
 (SELECT rpt_ret FROM rpt x WHERE x.fiscal_year=s.fiscal_year AND x.region=s.region) rpt_ret
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r ON r.fiscal_year=s.fiscal_year AND r.region=s.region AND r.store_id=s.store_id
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, count(DISTINCT d.fiscal_week) weeks_with_sales, min(d.fiscal_week) minw, max(d.fiscal_week) maxw, sum(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_period<=5
GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(DISTINCT d.fiscal_week) < 21 OR s.store_id IN (136,137,129,125,119) ORDER BY 1,2

WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900),
weeks AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, min(calendar_date) wk_start, max(calendar_date) wk_end FROM dim_date
  WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_period <= 5 GROUP BY 1,2),
sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(f.net_amount) amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_period <= 5 GROUP BY ALL),
rets AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(r.refund_net) amt
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_period <= 5 GROUP BY ALL),
net AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_week, s.amt - coalesce(r.amt,0) net_sales
  FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (store_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_week)),
-- like-for-like pairs: store traded in the same fiscal week in both years, store open before the base year began (excludes 136, 137)
pairs AS (
  SELECT c.region, n1.store_id, n1.fiscal_week, n0.net_sales ly, n1.net_sales ty
  FROM net n1 JOIN net n0 ON n0.store_id=n1.store_id AND n0.fiscal_week=n1.fiscal_week AND n0.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
  JOIN cur c ON c.store_id=n1.store_id
  WHERE n1.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND n1.store_id NOT IN (136,137))
SELECT region, count(DISTINCT store_id) stores, round(sum(ty),2) ty_net, round(sum(ly),2) ly_net, round((sum(ty)/sum(ly)-1)*100,2) lfl_growth_pct
FROM pairs GROUP BY region ORDER BY lfl_growth_pct DESC
